final: WITH line AS (SELECT invoice_number, CAST(derived_product_cost AS REAL) / derived_total_cost AS r FROM Invoice_Line_Items), inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(r) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_items FROM line GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_items, inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC, inv.invoice_number LIMIT 10
